title: BDEngine Porter
description: A tool for adding models from Block-display.com to your server
body:
# **Plugin description**
With the BDEngine porter, you can spawn models directly from block-display.com. Simply use the "Export to Minecraft Server" function, copy the ID, and paste it into the command!

## **How to use the plugin**
1. **Open any model** in [BDEngine](https://beta.bdengine.app/) or [block-display.com](https://block-display.com/)
2. Click **"Get the command"** or **"Export to Minecraft"** -> **"Export for Server"**
3. **Copy** the resulting **ID** into the **/bde spawn [id] command**

For more details, you can read the website's documentation: [Server API Docs](https://block-display.com/server-api-guides/?gp=how)

## **BETA testing status**
The plugin is in beta testing, in the future many features will be added for managing your models, you can support me by downloading the plugin
